on_screen_text.text: President Biden on Russian Oil Ban & Protecting Americans

spoken_summary: President Biden announces he will do everything he can to minimize "Putin's price hike" in the US. He details a coordinated plan with partners to release 60 million barrels of oil from joint reserves, with 30 million of those barrels coming from the United States. He concludes by stating his administration will use every tool available to protect American families and businesses.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of Joe Biden's spoken remarks. There is no background music or other sound.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static, talking-head shot with no cuts or edits.
central_claim: President Biden is taking concrete steps, such as releasing oil from strategic reserves, to protect Americans from rising energy prices caused by the ban on Russian oil.
intended_effect: To reassure viewers that the administration is proactively managing the economic impact of its foreign policy and protecting American consumers.
